floorFailures.floorFailure: Thesis Deposit Preflight was the one candidate to clear the gate at 23. The adversarial reviewer rescored it to 17 and the no-backfill rule forbade researching the next candidate down, so the day ended at zero. The rule, not the evidence, produced the empty file.

Best candidate was Orphaned Embed Rescue at 21, one point under the gate of 22, held back by free replacements and a one-time migration need. With no provisional tier the run had no way to ship its best candidate. Saturday's focus sources (RFP portals, job postings) mostly surfaced enterprise solicitations that the no-procurement rejection rule kills by construction.

A8 yielded nothing because Reddit is unreachable, so a quarter of the run's source budget was spent on a dead source the morning run had already found dead. The strongest signal, the end of Canvas Free-for-Teacher, is already served by free Canvas Lite and ProfDesk.

Fresh Canvas pain was either already served (Atomic Search sells account-wide Find and Replace) or bound up with minors' data. EdSurge, EdWeek Market Brief and pulse.bot returned no usable October 2026 content through WebFetch.
